"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the XZ plane for sketch coordinates
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

# Convert local sketch coordinates (u, v) to world coordinates (x, y, z) = (u, 0, v)
def to_world(local_pt):
    return P.toWorldCoords(local_pt)

# Key points for the closed profile
p_start = to_world((25, 0))          # Rightmost point (start of line 1 / end of spline)
p_mid = to_world((4, -24))            # Bottom middle point (junction of two lines)
p_left = to_world((-25, 0))           # Leftmost point (end of line 2 / start of spline)

# Spline control points (fit points) in order
spline_points = [
    p_left,
    to_world((-8.333333, 24)),
    to_world((8.333333, 24)),
    p_start
]

# Create the three curve entities
line1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_start, p_mid)          # Line: (25, 0) -> (4, -24)
line2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_mid, p_left)           # Line: (4, -24) -> (-25, 0)
spline = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_points)        # Spline: (-25, 0) -> (-8.333, 24) -> (8.333, 24) -> (25, 0)

# Combine into a single compound
edges = [line1, line2, spline]
compound = cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges)

# Export to step format
cq.exporters.export(compound, "sketch.step")"
